# Requirement (S7 repeatability fixture)

We sell installation services from our main company and want salespeople to give per-line discounts
and use pricelists. We are opening a Mexican subsidiary that sells in MXN with its own chart of
accounts, its own sales team and pipeline stage, a price list with a fixed installation price, and
quotations that stay valid for 15 days and are signed online. Industrial customers get their own
contact tag, and training opportunities reuse the existing "Training" CRM tag. Loyalty and promotion
programs will come later, but the app should be ready. As a first real case, record the opportunity and
the confirmed order for our first Mexican industrial customer.
